original_download.encoding: UTF-8 with three-byte BOM and CRLF line endings

packaged_representation.encoding: UTF-8 without BOM and LF line endings

transformation_provenance.stage: Prior release packaging, not scientific analysis
transformation_provenance.implementation: Retired src/wr_build_release.py portable_transform: decode_text tries utf-8-sig, then CRLF and CR are replaced by LF before UTF-8 encoding
transformation_provenance.current_release_action: Retain the baseline packaged bytes unchanged; record the encoding difference explicitly

inverse_byte_proof.operation: Prefix UTF-8 BOM bytes EF BB BF and replace every LF byte with CR LF in the packaged representation
inverse_byte_proof.byte_difference_accounted_for: 1743889 restored carriage-return bytes plus the three-byte UTF-8 BOM

analytical_content.basis: The exact inverse-byte digest proves that the difference consists solely of BOM removal and newline encoding. Numeric observations, field and record order, delimiters and quotation content were not edited.

reader_behavior.inspection: Read-only code review; the full raw-source pipeline was not rerun
reader_behavior.analysis_reader: src/additional_validation.py create_california_pairs uses DuckDB read_csv_auto with header=true, all_varchar=true and sample_size=200000
reader_behavior.workflow: src/run_workflow.py expects CLIP from the extracted full-data package. src/acquire_data.py verifies the seven EPA archives, and src/wr_acquire_california.py verifies SDWIS4.zip; neither checks or redownloads CLIP.
reader_behavior.verification_instruction: Use the packaged-representation digest for the distributed CLIP CSV, the original-download digest for a fresh publisher download, and the inverse proof to reconcile the two. The acquisition manifest intentionally retains the original source digest.

limitations: This encoding audit is not an end-to-end raw-source reproduction or a fresh remote acquisition. Public availability and source-specific redistribution terms must still be checked.
